mutations.name: c1: sweep_orphans lists the source folders from disk, not the store
mutations.old: (base / name for name in list_children(base) if name not in known)
mutations.new: (base / p.name for p in base.iterdir() if p.name not in known)

mutations.name: c2: sweep_orphans deletes a recording from disk, not through the store
c3: the raw .tmp-* leg of sweep_orphans is dropped
c4: stored_reviews lists from disk, not the store
mutations.new: for n in [p.name for p in folder.glob("*.json")])

mutations.name: c5: the approval history lists projects from disk, not the store
mutations.new: for name in [p.name for p in store.paths.dir.parent.iterdir()]
